caption: The drawing features a single wooden washstand with a brown finish, depicted in a three-quarter view against an off-white or light beige plain background. The washstand has four straight, tapered legs and a rectangular top surface with a slightly raised, scalloped border at three sides. There is a circular opening cut into the top left area of the surface. Below the top, there is one central drawer fitted with a round knob in the middle; the drawer is slightly worn at the top left corner, revealing a lighter color. Beneath the drawer, there is an open shelf connecting the legs horizontally. The overall composition is centered, and the washstand is the only object in the image. There is a small printed or stamped label in the lower left area of the drawing that reads "THOMAS JEFFERSON'S WASHSTAND."
title: Wash-stand
